cards.name: Email - Orange
cards.summary: Symbol 'Email - Orange' from Illustrator's Mobile symbol library: a glossy round button, golden yellow brightening to pale yellow near the bottom, with a darker amber rim and a faint amber drop shadow under the glyph, holding a black envelope outline with a V-shaped flap. The name says Orange, but the picture is gold-yellow and amber rather than a true orange; the picture wins. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 64 x 64 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a labelled button: the icon has no text; add the label beside it with the Type tool
a calm neutral look: the gold-yellow button is loud; use the Grey version for secondary buttons
a flat or modern look: the glossy bevel is baked in; break the link and set flat fills for a flat UI
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Mobile; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Email - Orange")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Mobile.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Gold-yellow glossy button (body sampled hue 43-51 degrees, rim about 230,159,47 amber), not true orange, with a black envelope outline with V flap, as described.

verified.note: Gold-yellow glossy button (hue about 45 degrees) with a black mobile phone whose screen and button are cut-outs showing yellow.

cards.name: Photo - Grey
cards.summary: Symbol 'Photo - Grey' from Illustrator's Mobile symbol library: a glossy round button, silver-white at the top shading to pale grey-blue at the lower right, with a grey-blue rim and a faint cool-grey drop shadow under the glyph, holding a black outline of a camera with a round lens ring and a small viewfinder bump on top. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 64 x 64 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a labelled button: the icon has no text; add the label beside it with the Type tool
a coloured accent: the grey button is neutral; use the Orange version for the active or primary state
a flat or modern look: the glossy bevel is baked in; break the link and set flat fills for a flat UI
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
